svg.title: The NeuralGraph memory pipeline
svg.desc: Write path: a conversation turn is queued, extracted asynchronously by a leased worker, grounded against the source text and reconciled, then committed to the persistent graph in SQLite. The graph holds memories, entities, a speaker and typed relations; a newer memory supersedes an older one, which is kept as history. Read path: vector and BM25 channels, plus an optional entity-graph channel that is off by default, are fused by Reciprocal Rank Fusion, filtered by an evidence floor, and returned to the agent as context.
